findings.summary: The only cold-setup reading taken after all of M19.28's speed rows (301a587, after M19.61 and M19.60) is 410 s. That is the highest of the three and 10 s under the 420 s target. The median of 345 s comes from two readings taken before M19.57, M19.60 and M19.61. The leg is honest as M19.28 specified it, but the speed rows have not been shown to lower cold setup. The new parallel docs step after the barrier may add contention on 4-vCPU runners, or the 410 s may be noise.

The FR-AI-011 build-output check now runs only inside precommit's buildDocs(). build-settle.test.mjs pins the docs step and its runAsync call by regex, but not the docsOutputProblem call. A mutant that returns `built` without checking the output survives every test. The old guide-drift case was also weak, since it was skipIf'd on a source-only checkout, so this is no regression. The check simply has no constraining test of its wiring.

dispositions.note: No M19 requirement is affected. Plan row 21's EARS SHALL is that every FR/NFR stays traced, which check-trace shows. Its measurable target, cold setup in CI at most 420 s by median of 3, is met. The items list is the row's WHEN condition, and the human allowance covered cuts. Each self-amendment states its measured reason. For later plans: a split row lists every item it takes from its parent, and a checkpoint, not the row's own commit, ratifies any that are left out. checkpoint.test.mjs's speed can go into a later test-speed row if cold setup or verify time comes back over budget.

M19.28's leg is met as specified (3 readings, median 345 s at most 420 s, all descended from b7f9ac5 on the current lockfile), and budget.json records the 410 s reading openly. Readings vary by about 80 s between runs. If the next CI cold-setup readings in M20 run above 420 s, the first thing to suspect is the docs step's overlap after the barrier (M19.61), and a Fixes row opens. No threshold is raised.

No gate is weakened: the old case was skipped whenever dist was missing, and the new step fails the ladder when the build or its output falls short. Pinning the docsOutputProblem call in build-settle.test.mjs is a one-line hygiene change that can ride on the next harness row that touches precommit.mjs. It is not a defect of an M19 requirement.
